messages:
Liam: Hi all, Liam here (first day!). I can't join the corporate Wi-Fi network (redwood-enterprise). It prompts for a certificate and then just fails to authenticate. Tried rebooting and forgetting the network.
it-ops: welcome Liam :wave: are you on a company laptop or personal? and which OS?
Liam: company MacBook Air M2, macOS Ventura 13.5. Laptop was imaged yesterday by IT. I see a "Verify profile" popup but when I tap it nothing happens.
it-bot: created ticket INC-5919 for Liam (priority: high)  https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-5919
Kira: @it-ops tagging - sometimes the SCEP cert push via Jamf hasn't completed. Liam, open System Settings -> Profiles and see if there's a "Redwood WiFi Cert" profile pending.
Liam: I see a profile named "redwood-wifi-cert" but it shows an alert icon and says "Installation incomplete". Clicking shows "Install" but it asks for Admin password and my account doesn't have that.
it-ops: ok that's a Jamf install that needs the MDM enrollment token to finish. We can complete remotely. Liam, can you start a Jamf remote session or give us a time window?
Liam: available now for a remote. Also I have my phone hotspot as backup but need corporate access for Slack/Okta.
it-ops: starting remote session now. Please accept the Jamf prompt.
Sam: FYI, if the profile install keeps failing it's often because of duplicate device serial entries in Jamf (rare). We'll check.
it-ops: remote session complete. We re-pushed the SCEP cert and restarted the MDM service on the device. Please try Wi-Fi now.
Liam: connecting... it asked to trust a certificate and then connected! Slack and Okta login work.
it-ops: great. marking INC-5919 resolved and leaving a note to investigate Jamf enrollment flakiness for recent imaged laptops.
Kira: adding a short KB to new-hire onboarding: "Wi-Fi cert install stuck? Start Jamf remote, check Profiles -> reinstall SCEP cert, contact it-ops".
Liam: thanks everyone  appreciate the quick help! :tada:
